svg.title: The same word, different money: Bohemia's administrative escrow
svg.desc: An original editorial evidence diagram differentiating $48,087.59 in the Louisiana Department of Natural Resources' claimant application-cost escrow as of September 30, 2021 from separate mineral royalty judgments and court-registry payments, which the 2021 report does not reconcile. The graphic does not establish any beneficiary payment or the account's later status.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios, Investigations Editorial Research. Created: 2026-11-16. Copyright 2026 Final Vestige Studios, all rights reserved. Original graphic composed only of vectors and text, not a historical photo or AI-generated reconstruction. Documentary source: Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, Cash Management Review Board, Act 361 of 2017 monthly escrow report dated September 30, 2021, printed page 4, https://jlcb.legis.la.gov/Docs/2021/oct/October%202021%20RTC%20Act%20361%20of%202017%20monthly%20report%20-%20September.pdf . Supporting historical distinction: Fifth Circuit, Haspel & Davis Milling & Planting Co. v. Board of Levee Commissioners, 493 F.3d 570 (July 23, 2007), https://www.ca5.uscourts.gov/Opinions/pub/07/07-30086-CV0.wpd.pdf . Suggested alt: The 2021 government escrow report lists $48,087.59 for DNR Bohemia claimant application-cost advances; it does not measure the separate mineral-royalty judgment payments or beneficiary distributions. Caption: Original Final Vestige Studios evidence diagram based on the Louisiana Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget's September 2021 escrow account report, page 4. The report shows an unchanged balance within that month, not proof of inactivity through intervening years or current cash balance.
